text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: routing-proxy-503-pulse (prod-west) — 24 events in 60s — alert rule: proxy-5xx-spike

incident-bot: link: https://pd.example/org/incidents/PD-98765 — runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/proxy-5xx

devon: acked — i'm taking this. pulling proxy logs and router metrics now.

maria: thx. heads-up, i'm swapping oncall in 3m if you need handoff.

sre-oncall: quick glance at dashboards — 503 spike centered on proxy-pool-a, ~10s bursts, backend latency normal, cpu/memory fine. Sounds like a readiness/healthcheck storm.

devon: logs show lots of grpc healthcheck timeouts from <10.0.3.*/healthz> around the same window. example from proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-17T10:07:12Z] proxy-1 | upstream: backend-42 timed out (deadline exceeded) status=503 path=/api/v1/healthz
[2026-03-17T10:07:13Z] proxy-3 | upstream: backend-12 closed conn status=503
```

tj: if it's k8s readiness churn that's noisy and low-impact — i'd rather silence PD for this rule and monitor. i'll apply a temporary suppression (10m) scoped to prod-west/proxy-5xx-spike.

devon: +1 to temporary suppress. adding note to PD: "muted while we verify healthcheck noise". no customer-visible errors in SLO dashboard (p95 success unchanged).

maria: started a rolling-deploy about the same time; i'm going to backfill why readiness probes spiked — maybe probe timeout too low after longer app startup. filing follow-up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (duration 3m 5s) — condition returned below threshold.

devon: closing initial triage — root cause likely rolling deploy + aggressive readiness probe combined with probe fanout. no customer impact based on SLOs and product dashboards.

tj: created PD suppression and raised infra ticket INFRA-1432: "Increase readiness probe jitter + backoff for new deploys" — https://issues.redwood/INFRA-1432

maria: assigning followup to infra-team for next-day work. will monitor for recurrence. if repeats within 24h we re-open escalation.

sre-oncall: sounds good. note for runbook update: add step to check k8s deploy windows + set temporary suppression if probe-only. small tweak to alert rule might prevent future flapping. :white_check_mark:

devon: leaving thread — will add short incident note in pagerduty and close. thanks all.
